#4063 (deep): the merge of #4633 closed the ticket by mistake (its body quoted 'does not close' before the ticket number; GitHub reads that as a closing keyword) and removed my adopted claim. I reopened #4063, but the pacer gave it to a new run (pacer-r4f90bebc49) first, so I opened no PR. The work is on branch claude/dreamy-turing-cbp67a (commit 3f843d2, Part of #4063): a villager that attacks an enemy unit counts as busy up to the last record command of the enemy (offline de-64.3: P1 250:19 -> 246:41, P2 265:37 -> 241:04), and ship_pr.py stops a 'Part of #N' body that GitHub reads as closing #N. Tests: tests/test_replay_idle_fight.py, tests/test_ship_pr_part.py. The run that owns #4063 can cherry-pick 3f843d2. Rest by cause: most of it looks like real idle time in the record (an empty farm, then a new farm 17 min later; a garrison in a full town center; house and town center builders; moves). Spawns at the empty gold mine (151,447) give P1 24 min: the next gold is 10.8 tiles away.
